topics.subject: Physics
topics.title: Kinematics
topics.summary: Describes motion using displacement, velocity, acceleration, and time.
facts: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity.
SI units are metre, second, and metre per second squared.

topics.subject: Physics
topics.title: Newton's Laws
topics.summary: Newton's laws connect force, mass, acceleration, and momentum.
facts: Forces are vectors and are measured in newtons.
The net force determines acceleration.

topics.subject: Physics
topics.title: Work, Energy and Power
topics.summary: Energy is transferred by work and the rate of transfer is power.
facts: Energy is measured in joules.
Power is measured in watts.

topics.subject: Physics
topics.title: Circuits and Ohm's Law
topics.summary: Voltage, current, and resistance describe simple electrical circuits.
facts: Current is charge flow per second.
Resistance is measured in ohms.

topics.subject: Physics
topics.title: Waves and Sound
topics.summary: Waves transfer energy and are described by frequency, wavelength, and speed.
facts: Frequency is measured in hertz.
Sound needs a medium to travel.

topics.subject: Chemistry
topics.title: Atoms and the Periodic Table
topics.summary: Atoms contain protons, neutrons, and electrons arranged into energy levels.
facts: Atomic number is the number of protons.
Isotopes have the same proton count but different neutron counts.

topics.subject: Chemistry
topics.title: Stoichiometry
topics.summary: Balanced equations provide mole ratios for quantitative chemical calculations.
facts: Equations must conserve each element.
The limiting reagent determines the maximum product.

topics.subject: Chemistry
topics.title: Solutions and Concentration
topics.summary: Concentration describes how much solute is present in a given amount of solution.
facts: Molarity uses litres of solution.
Dilution changes concentration but not solute moles.

topics.subject: Chemistry
topics.title: Acids, Bases and pH
topics.summary: The pH scale describes hydrogen ion concentration in aqueous solutions.
facts: At 25 C, pH 7 is neutral.
A one-unit pH change represents a tenfold concentration change.

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.title: Algebra and Quadratics
topics.summary: Algebra uses symbols and rules to represent relationships and solve unknowns.
facts: The discriminant classifies the roots of a quadratic.
Always check solutions in the original equation.

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.title: Functions and Graphs
topics.summary: A function maps each allowed input to exactly one output.
facts: The domain contains valid inputs.
The range contains resulting outputs.

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.title: Derivatives and Integrals
topics.summary: Derivatives measure instantaneous change and integrals accumulate quantities.
facts: A derivative is the slope of a curve.
A definite integral represents signed area.

topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.title: Probability and Statistics
topics.summary: Statistics summarizes data while probability models uncertain events.
formulas: P(A or B) = P(A)+P(B)-P(A and B)
facts: The median is less sensitive to outliers than the mean.
Probability lies between zero and one.
